statement.text:
Let F be a soluble saturated Fitting formation. Is it true that lF (G) ⩽
f (cF (G)), where cF (G) is the length of a composition series of some F-covering sub-
group of a finite soluble group G? This is Problem 17 in (L. A. Shemetkov, Formations
of Finite Groups, Moscow, Nauka, 1978 (Russian)). For the definition of the F-length
lF (G), see ibid.                                                     L. A. Shemetkov
